Senses.Explanation: Mind-ground is the mind described as the ground in which things arise, are established, or are cultivated. Verses say that it contains seeds or is originally unborn; instructions speak of clarifying it, a mind-ground teaching gate, or a seal of the mind-ground. The image supplies a ground relation—support, source, or field—while each passage states the particular predicate.
Senses.Note: The frozen corpus has 1,806 exact hits in 295 files representing 291 works. Eight anchors cover explicit predicates, verses, direct questions, instruction, and the seal compound across independent works.

Occurrences.Kwic: 所謂心地法門。萬法皆依此心建立。遇境即有無境即無。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: (黃檗山斷際禪師傳心法要). Huangbo Xiyun is the exact actor: his continuous discourse defines (心地法門).

Occurrences.Kwic: 心地本無生因地從緣起緣種不相妨華果亦復爾
Occurrences.AttributionNote: (景德傳燈錄). Sanghanandi is the exact actor: (即付法偈曰) introduces (心地本無生).

Occurrences.Kwic: 雲峰因僧問：如何是心地法門？峰曰：不從人得。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: (宗門拈古彙集), Yunfeng Wenyue section. The exact headword-bearing speaker is an unnamed questioning monk: he asks Yunfeng what the mind-ground teaching gate is, and Yunfeng answers that it is not obtained from another. All six rungs leave the monk unnamed.

Occurrences.Kwic: 拈起拄杖，云：「這箇是心地印。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: (國清大庾韜禪師語錄), instruction to the assembly. Guoqing Dayu Xingtao is the exact speaker: he raises his staff and declares, 'This is the mind-ground seal,' then draws one stroke and identifies it as the patriarchal barrier.

Occurrences.Kwic: 所以六祖云。心地含諸種。普雨悉皆萌。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Extensive Record of Chan Master Hongzhi (宏智禪師廣錄): Hongzhi Zhengjue explicitly quotes the Sixth Patriarch; Huineng is the exact speaker of ‘Mind-ground contains all seeds; universal rain makes them sprout.’

Occurrences.Kwic: 中下之流，須當漸次發明心地。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Complete Collection (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)), section on Shanquan Huitai: Huitai says that those of middling and lower capacity must gradually clarify the mind-ground.

Occurrences.Kwic: 未說他悟明心地只存這一念正因知有善知識可憑可仗
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Dahui’s General Addresses (大慧普覺禪師普說): Dahui Zonggao directly contrasts clarifying the mind-ground with preserving a single sound causal resolve.

Occurrences.Kwic: 南陽忠國師云。禪宗法者。應依佛語一乘了義。契取本原心地。轉相傳授。與佛道同。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Record of the Mirror of the Teaching (宗鏡錄), in an explicit quotation introduced as Nanyang Huizhong’s words: Huizhong instructs practitioners to accord with the original mind-ground and transmit it in turn.
